headline: Low interaction risk overall; no shared channels or write paths are exposed, but B can process audio files while A is only a docs index, so pairwise pathways are limited and mostly indirect.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared communication channel is exposed: agent_a has no I/O surfaces or execution surfaces, and agent_b only reads audio files with no clipboard, stdin/stdout, MCP, or filesystem write. That makes prompt injection via direct output ingestion or shared workspace provably absent from the profiles.
conditions: IF a shared filesystem, clipboard, or message queue is later enabled between the agents, reassess injection risk.
IF agent_b begins parsing agent_a-generated text as instructions, the pathway changes materially.
mitigations: Keep the agents on separate workspaces.
Do not add clipboard or shared-folder bridges.
Require explicit human copy-paste for any handoff.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Agent_a is a knowledge-management index with network_egress none and no data classes touched; agent_b touches audio/speech only and has no read_filesystem, write_filesystem, or network egress. With no shared workspace or outbound transfer path, there is no plausible leakage route between them in the profiles.
conditions: IF either agent is connected to a shared workspace or external upload service, leakage risk must be re-evaluated.
IF agent_a begins storing sensitive documents, the current no-leak conclusion no longer holds.
mitigations: Avoid shared folders or synced drives.
Do not route audio files through any third-party service.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: There is no overlapping mutable surface: agent_a has no write or git capabilities exposed, and agent_b explicitly cannot write_filesystem, modify_git_state, or execute_shell. Without shared write access or concurrency primitives, capability conflict is blocked by the profiles.
conditions: IF agent_a is later given filesystem or git write access, reassess for overlap.
IF agent_b is wrapped by an orchestrator that adds shared mutable state, conflict risk may emerge.
mitigations: Keep write access disabled for both agents.
Run only one instance of agent_b at a time.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Agent_b does not expose downstream action-taking tools and agent_a is a static knowledge-management index, so there is no default chain where A's output drives irreversible actions. The only plausible cascade is indirect human misuse of indexed content, which is limited and not automated.
conditions: IF agent_a content is later treated as authoritative operational guidance, cascade risk increases.
IF agent_b is connected to an action-taking wrapper, the current low rating no longer applies.
mitigations: Require human review before acting on outputs.
Label agent_a content as unverified reference material.
Do not connect agent_b to email, shell, or deployment tools.

E_compliance.rationale: No compliance mismatch is evidenced: agent_a touches no data classes and has no egress, while agent_b only touches audio/speech and has no network or filesystem access. The profiles do not show residency, retention, or regulated-data handling differences, so a compliance breach pathway is not established.
conditions: IF regulated audio or personal data is introduced into agent_b, compliance must be reassessed.
IF agent_a begins indexing regulated documents, residency and retention controls should be checked.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of the pair.
Review data handling if scope expands.
